bundles.title: Role bundles
bundles.intro: A job description in one click. Granting a bundle sets the agent's role and adds its skills, MCP servers and connections in a single write. You see exactly what changes before anything is written.

note.catalogOffline: the skills catalog is unavailable right now

market.title: Skills
market.intro: The public skills catalog. A skill is instructions that run inside an agent with your tools and keys, so read its source before you install it. Install for every agent on this machine, or for one agent only.
market.stale: Showing a saved copy of the catalog; it could not be refreshed. {{error}}
market.unreachable: The skills catalog could not be loaded
market.manualTitle: This entry has no folder the installer can fetch; open its source to install it yourself.
market.notFound: No installable copy of this skill was found.
market.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{count}}; search to narrow it down

installed.perAgentEmpty: No skill has been given to a single agent yet. Grant one from the Marketplace or Who has what.
installed.machineIntro: Skills in your Claude skills folder. Every Claude Code agent loads these.
installed.machineEmpty: None installed for the whole machine.
installed.builtinIntro: Shipped with the app and copied into every agent's own folder each time it starts.
installed.mcpIntro: Servers switched on here reach every Claude Code agent. A server granted to one agent reaches only that agent. Servers that write outside the workspace or need a key stay off until you switch them on.
installed.consentTitle: This server can write beyond the workspace or uses a key. Switching it on lets every Claude Code agent use it.
installed.connectionsIntro: Connections are reached through the app's local broker, which holds the key: an agent never sees it. Temps and workers can use every connection that is switched on; any other agent only the ones granted to it.

restart.title: Restart {{name}} and continue its conversation, with its new capabilities

who.intro: Every agent on the floor against every skill, MCP server and connection anyone has. Click a cell to grant it to that agent or take it away; click a name for the agent's own panel.
who.emptyBody: Add an agent, then grant it skills, servers and connections here.
who.noColumns: Nobody has any skills, servers or connections yet
who.engineNote: {{engine}} does not read Claude Code skills or MCP settings; only its connections apply.
who.pendingRestart: This agent runs on an older setup than its grants.
who.confirmClear: Click again to take it all away

temps.intro: Hire an agent for one job. It works in its own worktree, is let go when it says it is done, and leaves a row behind: the job, how long it ran, the tokens it used, and any worktree it kept because it holds unmerged work.
temps.jobPlaceholder: Translate the changelog into Spanish and open a branch with it
temps.worktreeTitle: Work on a fresh branch in its own worktree, so nothing it does touches your checkout.
temps.hireNote: It starts in a moment, or as soon as a slot is free.
temps.historyEmpty: Finished temps leave a row here.
temps.keptUnknown: git could not say, so it was kept

why.rejected: The worker controller turned it down; your orchestrator was told why.
why.lost: It was handed over but never reached the floor.
why.interrupted: The app quit before it started.

errors.jobTooLong: The job is too long (4,000 characters at most).
errors.provider: That engine cannot take a job from the inbox.
errors.model: That model name has characters the command line cannot take.
errors.tooMany: Too many temps are waiting already.
